name: vaporhub
description: Outil de gestion et suivi de contenu

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACK,FRONT,DISCORD" -c "magenta,cyan,blue" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:discord"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && npm run db:migrate --prefix Backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:discord
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix Backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix Frontend && npm run test:coverage --prefix Discord
